title: Assess strict closing-observation binding equality after a successor advances the work revision
outcome: Decide whether revision/fence-only advances legitimately invalidate retained adopted-turn closing capture, without weakening claim/root/store/connection authority by accident.
acceptance: Record an independently reviewed decision on strict binding equality for closing capture, including the queued-successor and work-note cases, before any behavior change.
If behavior changes, preserve fail-closed handling of a genuinely different claim/root/store/connection and verify the chosen boundary through production-owner regressions.
